steps.label: Resting 3x3x3 block at the default radius (spacing 2.0), y in [8,12]
Container walls sized for the default-scale block
Precondition: no outflow regions registered yet
Register a drain slab spanning the container floor's full XZ footprint
Block falls under gravity and drains through the floor slab (~4s)
Change: particles that reached the drain have been deleted -- count is measurably lower than the seed count
Invariant: no NaN/explosion among whatever particles remain
Run further: drained count never grows back once particles are removed
Invariant: particle count is exactly preserved from the moment of the first drain-count sample
Clearing outflow regions stops further removal
